brief:
Netanyahu and Israel's military leadership are at odds over how to assess the Iranian nuclear threat, Ma'an Wire reported. The disagreement centers on the severity of Tehran's nuclear capabilities and the urgency of potential Israeli response options.

Details of the specific positions held by Netanyahu and senior military officials remain unclear, though such disputes have historically reflected broader tensions within Israel's security establishment over Iran policy and military readiness assessments.

title: Netanyahu and Israeli military clash over Iran nuclear threat level
